purpose: Provide a deterministic conservative preflight that detects provable local conflicts among translation mounts and axis/fixed-direction translation locks and limits that constrain the same normalized projection.

properties.constraints: existing UC translation mounts, axis locks/limits, fixed-direction locks/limits, with distance families accepted only for unsupported-family reporting

limitations: does not prove global satisfiability, convergence, stability or physical correctness
distance joints and distance limits are reported but not analyzed in v0.1
near-parallel but non-identical directions are intentionally not merged
disabled analyzed constraints are validated but excluded from conflict intersections
does not change solver order, world state, collision behavior or donor source

proves: translation mounts conflict-check against aligned axis locks
axis and scaled fixed-direction constraints share an exact normalized projection group
disabled conflicting constraints remain inert while invalid references still fail validation
nonlinear distance families are reported without unsupported classification claims
same-runtime report checksum replay is deterministic

truth.basis: Only conflicts proven by interval intersection on exactly matched normalized projections are reported; unsupported nonlinear and near-parallel cases remain explicit non-claims.

agency.basis: The preflight is advisory evidence; it does not silently mutate constraints or block the caller from choosing a repair.

continuity.basis: It reuses existing constraint normalizers and leaves the byte-for-byte donor physics source and existing solver behavior unchanged.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: It surfaces locally provable contradictions before callers spend bounded solver passes on constraints that cannot share one projected interval.
